name: Blue Jet Healthcare Ltd
title: Blue Jet Healthcare Ltd - 544009 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Blue Jet FY26 revenue fell 8% to INR947 crores on PI/API destocking, while Q4 contrast media revenue rose 91% YoY to INR193 crores.
summary.overview: FY26 revenue from operations was INR947 crores, down 8% YoY, with reported EBITDA margin at 31% versus 37% in FY25 as PI/API volumes fell 35%. Contrast media was the offset, growing 23% to INR495 crores for the year and 91% YoY in Q4 to INR193 crores. Management said PI/API destocking is complete and shipments are resuming, and it is ramping investment in Vizag (about INR1,000 crores over roughly 3 years), Mahad Unit 3 and a Hyderabad R&D centre. The company remains debt-free with INR400 crores of liquid assets.

segments.name: Contrast media
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR495 crores (+23%); Q4 INR193 crores (+91% YoY). Flagship product volumes up vs FY25 despite goods in transit; customer FY27 forecast implies mid-single-digit growth for that product. NCE intermediate commercialised in FY25 saw strong FY26 offtake.

segments.name: PI/API (pharma intermediates)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR298 crores (-35%), driven by destocking of a cardiovascular intermediate by an innovator customer. Q4 revenue collapsed to INR2.4 crores from INR40 crores in Q3, with management saying destocking is now complete.

segments.name: Artificial sweetener
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR131 crores (-2%); Q4 INR37 crores (+43% QoQ, -24% YoY). Management cited pricing pressure from imports; one high-volume product is under validation with trial shipments expected over coming quarters.

guidance_outlook: Contrast media: management expects double-digit growth in FY27, backed by one or two validations and one commercial launch; molecules include gadolinium and iodinated products. Management declined to quantify.
PI/API: management expects FY27 to exceed the FY25 peak, citing supply-network participation with the innovator customer, but gave no formal guidance.
Margins: management would not guide FY27 margins; Q1 FY27 cost structure to be assessed. Freight costs rose after March 2026 and the FY27 logistics impact is still to be evaluated.
Mahad Unit 3 (backward integration) expected to start production in H2 FY27, with a slow ramp-up.
Hyderabad R&D centre (about INR40 crores) to go live in H2 FY27; product development spend to rise in FY27.
FY27 capex of roughly INR400 crores across Vizag, completion of Mahad and Ambernath additions.
Vizag capacity expected online in 24-30 months; 3-4 contrast media launches and about 2 PI/CDMO opportunities expected to reach commercialisation in FY27.
capex_capacity: Vizag greenfield (about 100 acres): total capex about INR1,000 crores over about 3 years; Phase 1 covers contrast media intermediates, high-intensity sweeteners and pharma intermediates; development activities underway after groundbreaking.
Mahad Unit 3: backward integration project for a key contrast media raw material is progressing; plant expected to go onstream this year.
Mahad facility in final stages of completion; commercial production expected H2 FY27.
Management says contrast media is far from peak utilisation due to ongoing debottlenecking and capacity creation.
Hyderabad R&D centre (about INR40 crores) for peptide intermediates, GLP-1-linked chemistry, biocatalysts and faster CDMO development turnaround.
demand_pricing: PI/API: destocking has happened and the plant is running at optimum capacity; management said the worst is behind for this segment.

Pipeline: about 20 active RFPs in PI/CDMO, mainly chronic therapy areas including GLP-1 and peptide building blocks; 2 expected to commercialise this year. Two high-conviction lateral entries are being evaluated, with dedicated Vizag capacity planned.
Peptides: lab supplies started to some innovators and large peptide CDMOs; management flagged faster price erosion risk in peptides than in contrast media or patented CDMO work.
Artificial sweetener: pricing pressure from imports; management will remain opportunistic.
Raw material costs rose in the last month of FY26 due to the Iran war; rupee depreciation offset this in FY26 and the company is in pass-through discussions with select customers.
Warning letter at one customer's sole formulation plant: management said there is no import alert and no current supply disruption.

qa_highlights.question: What gives confidence PI will exceed the FY25 peak, and is it confirmed?
qa_highlights.answer: VK Singh said destocking is done, some orders were held back and deferred, and new orders have come in after supply-chain realignment. New products will take time, so little is factored in.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the Q4 contrast media revenue is from goods shipped in Q3 (INR190 crores vs INR125 crores in Q3)?
qa_highlights.answer: Ganesh Karuppannan said goods in transit have normalised with no significant variance, so the full INR190 crores belongs to Q4 order book.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY27 a step-jump year for contrast media?
qa_highlights.answer: Shiven Arora said the focus is double-digit growth backed by new launches, and declined to say more about a step-jump.

qa_highlights.question: Will Mahad backward integration drive margins or top line?
qa_highlights.answer: VK Singh said the primary aim was supply independence from import price volatility; the two products also open third-party sales, but no numbers were given.

qa_highlights.question: What is the margin outlook for FY27 given freight and crude pressures?
qa_highlights.answer: Ganesh Karuppannan said it is too early to comment and that Q1 FY27 cost structures would be the better guide.

qa_highlights.question: Is the company raising funds, and is it linked to Vizag?
qa_highlights.answer: Ganesh Karuppannan said the situation is dynamic and an update will follow in coming quarters; the company is accelerating capex from its debt-free balance sheet.

risks_watch: FY27 margin pressure from freight and crude-linked raw material costs; management has not quantified the impact.
Contrast media growth depends on FY27 validations and launches, and monthly offtake is uneven; the FY26 Q4 surge may not be repeatable.
Vizag execution: about INR1,000 crores over 3 years, with a 24-30 month window for online capacity; FY27 capex about INR400 crores.
Customer regulatory risk: a warning letter at a customer's plant (no import alert yet) and a patent-protected molecule under change of ownership.
Peptide price erosion risk, and artificial sweetener import-driven pricing pressure.
Possible fundraise, with no detail given on size or use.
summary.management_tone: Confident on contrast media and on PI recovery, but guarded on margins and specifics; management withheld customer, molecule and pricing detail under confidentiality and declined to guide margins until Q1 FY27.
key_quotes: As we move into FY27, we believe that the company is gradually transitioning from an investment and preparation phase into a broader commercialization and growth cycle
So we are quite confident that in the PI segment, we are getting to a very good set of numbers in the coming year.
So from our standpoint, business as usual.

growth.why: Management expects contrast media double-digit growth in FY27 backed by 3-4 launches and 1-2 validations (no figures given), PI/API to exceed FY25 peak without formal guidance, and FY27 capex of ~INR400 crore with Mahad Unit 3 and Hyderabad R&D going live in H2 FY27.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Reported EBITDA margin fell to 31% from 37% in FY25, and management would not guide FY27 margins amid freight and crude-linked cost pressure.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.when: Q2 FY27 (Mahad Unit 3, Hyderabad R&D in H2 FY27); Vizag onli
rows.why: Mahad Unit 3 and Hyderabad R&D (about INR40 crores) are under construction with H2 FY27 go-live, and Vizag (about INR1,000 crores over ~3 years, INR400 crores in FY27) is under way after groundbreaking.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Contrast media revenue rose 91% YoY to INR193 crores in Q4 FY26 and PI/API has resumed shipments after destocking, though monthly offtake is uneven and the Q4 surge may not repeat.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.when: already under way; FY27 capex about INR400 crores
rows.why: Management says it is accelerating capex, with about INR400 crores planned for FY27 and about INR1,000 crores total for Vizag, and contrast media is far from peak utilisation.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management expects contrast media double-digit growth in FY27 and PI/API to exceed the FY25 peak (INR196 crores in Q4 FY25), but gave no formal figures.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Management declined to guide FY27 margins, freight costs rose after March 2026, and raw material costs jumped in the last month of FY26 with pass-through only in discussion.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Management expects 3-4 contrast media launches in the current year and about 2 PI/CDMO opportunities to commercialise in FY27, from about 20 active RFPs.

rows.label: Possible fundraise to accelerate Vizag capex
rows.why: Management said a fundraise is dynamic with an update in coming quarters, while the company is debt-free with INR400 crores of liquid assets against INR400 crores of FY27 capex.

rows.label: PI/API recovery after destocking
rows.why: PI/API revenue fell to INR2.4 crores in Q4 from INR40 crores in Q3 and INR298 crores in FY26, and management says new orders have come in with destocking complete, but FY27 is not formally guided.

rows.label: Peptide and artificial sweetener price erosion
rows.why: Management flagged faster peptide price erosion than in contrast media, and sweetener revenue fell 24% YoY in Q4 to INR37 crores on import-driven pricing pressure.

tone.note: Management was confident on contrast media growth, PI/API recovery and accelerating Vizag capex, but cautious on margins and declined to guide FY27 margins or quantify launches; analysts probed the Q4 contrast media surge, goods in transit, the step-jump question and the margin outlook.
